name: Shadow Blast
text:
Area varies

Defense basic Reflex save or basic Will save (target's choice)

---
You shape the shadow substance of the Netherworld into a blast. Choose @item.rank+1d8 acid, @item.rank+1d8 bludgeoning, @item.rank+1d8 cold, @item.rank+1d8 electricity, @item.rank+1d8 fire, @item.rank+1d8 force, @item.rank+1d8 piercing, @item.rank+1d8 slashing, @item.rank+1d8 sonic, or @item.rank+1d8 spirit damage, and choose a 30-foot cone, a 15-foot burst within 120 feet, or a 50-foot line. The blast deals 6d8 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area.

---
Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
